title: Flip
tagline: Corner the board. Flip the table.

lines.en: Sixty-four squares. Two colours. One quiet battle.
lines.zh: 六十四个格子，两种颜色，一场安静的对弈。

lines.en: Flip. Reversi for the family table.
lines.zh: 黑白棋。给一大家子的小游戏。

lines.en: Bracket a line and flip every disc between. Corners never move again.
lines.zh: 夹住一条线，翻掉中间的棋子。角上的棋子永远不会再翻。

lines.en: Four AI levels, from a gentle Companion to a four-ply Hard.
lines.zh: 四档 AI，从温和陪玩到四层搜索的挑战。

lines.en: Two players on one screen, or a phone joins over Wi-Fi.
lines.zh: 两人同屏，或者手机连同一 Wi-Fi 加入。

lines.en: Hints explain the shape. Undo, autosave and a family record are built in.
lines.zh: 提示会解释棋形；悔棋、自动保存和家庭战绩都已内置。

lines.en: Offline, no account, no ads. Just the board.
lines.zh: 离线、无账号、无广告，只剩棋盘。

lines.en: Flip. Corner the board. Flip the table.
